senses.sense_definition: A person who engages in illegal business activities, such as extortion or fraud, to make money.

examples.text: The police finally arrested the <w>racketeer</w> who had been threatening local shop owners for years.
He was known as a dangerous <w>racketeer</w> involved in several high-profile bribery cases.

senses.sense_definition: To participate in organized illegal business activities or criminal schemes.

examples.text: The organization was found to <w>racketeer</w> across several states using complex shell companies.
They were caught trying to <w>racketeer</w> through a series of fraudulent construction contracts.
